title: Roof Condition from Aerial Imagery

blueprintSignals.name: Roof segmentation
blueprintSignals.definition: intersection-over-union of the predicted roof mask with labelled outlines
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Shadows and tree edges confuse the mask

blueprintSignals.name: Material class
blueprintSignals.definition: predicted material from texture, such as tile, metal, asphalt or flat membrane

blueprintSignals.name: Damage score
blueprintSignals.definition: model score for missing tiles, staining, patching and sagging
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Resolution limits what the model can see

blueprintSignals.name: Image age
blueprintSignals.definition: months since the image capture date
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Metadata may be wrong, so validate

engineFeatures.meaning: how strongly a region stands out from its neighbourhood
the strongest local contrast anywhere in the image
contrast divided by the image's own noise level
which scanner or camera produced the image
augmentation that stops the model using overall brightness

label: For "Roof Condition from Aerial Imagery": Classify roof material, age and damage from aerial imagery for underwriting, maintenance and valuation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: The date of the imagery rarely matches the date of the decision, so errors rise in real use.
